materialization must preserve public claim boundaries
pack files must be machine-checkable before any public export or audit
supersedes: publishing diagnostic source-only artifacts without claim-boundary files

public_gates: M2505 must materialize the public benchmark pack files specified by M2504
M2505 must write README artifact_manifest claim_boundary actor_contract checkpoint_lineage scenario_role_diagnostics baseline_comparison_diagnostics known_limitations reproduce and summary files
M2505 must verify referenced source artifacts exist and actor contract states P0 observation shape 72 action shape 3
M2505 must verify claim boundaries reject performance success-rate ranking winner validation paper FW-vs-GRU and self-ID interpretations

M2505 must not execute policy actions train replay run PPO rank select a winner promote a checkpoint compute success rate or make verdict claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not install external simulator dependencies
do not import external high-fidelity simulation packages
do not run external high-fidelity simulation
do not execute policy actions in the materialization preflight
do not change the deployed action contract

do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: materializes a machine-checkable public diagnostic benchmark pack from the M2504 contract
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: engineering-controller public benchmark pack materialization only; no policy action, external simulation, measured validation, training, ranking, winner selection, success-rate verdict, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, self-ID, driver-performance, or validation verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if source artifacts are missing
stop if claim-boundary files cannot reject performance interpretations
stop if materialization would need hidden/oracle actor inputs
stop if pack would include a checkpoint binary copy or separate release repository
fallback_plan: route to artifact manifest repair if source paths are missing
route to claim-boundary repair if public wording is too strong
route to result audit if pack materialization validates
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2504 defined a bounded public benchmark pack contract

training_stage.stage_objective: engineering-controller public benchmark pack materialization preflight
admission_evidence: M2498/M2499 parameterized role metric panel artifacts
blocked_shortcuts: no external simulator installation or import
no policy action in the materialization milestone
allowed_updates: tests or validators for pack structure
M2505 status queue scoreboard research log and review

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2505 materializes an engineering diagnostic pack and does not test history necessity or current-frame substitution.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2505; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU comparison verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If pack materialization cannot preserve claim boundaries, route to repair rather than weakening self-ID or validation gates.
allowed_claims: engineering-controller public benchmark pack materialization preflight
no high-fidelity validation result, controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, current-sim verdict, driver-performance verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: creates a concrete public diagnostic artifact pack rather than another source-only metric loop
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: does not decide paper verdict but improves reproducibility and claim hygiene for public engineering artifacts
must_synthesize_if: pack materialization fails and another packaging repair is proposed repeatedly
pack wording cannot avoid performance claims
another public artifact task is proposed without validation or audit

hypothesis: A materialized public benchmark pack can make source-only engineering diagnostics reproducible and claim-bounded without executing policy actions or overstating driver performance.
success_criteria: actor_contract.md states P0 observation shape 72 and action shape 3
claim_boundary.md rejects performance ranking success-rate validation paper FW-vs-GRU and self-ID claims
summary gates mark success-rate ranking winner performance validation and paper claim flags false
no external high-fidelity simulation install import execution policy action training ranking winner success-rate or verdict claim is made
failure_criteria: M2505 installs imports or runs Chrono or another external simulator
M2505 changes actor input or action contract
M2505 injects hidden or oracle actor features
M2505 executes policy actions or rollout
M2505 treats benchmark pack materialization as driver performance
M2505 ranks controller families or selects a winner
M2505 claims high-fidelity validation paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID result
decision_rule: M2505 passes if it materializes a machine-checkable public benchmark pack with claim boundaries and registers a result audit without external simulation, policy action, training, ranking, winner selection, success-rate, or verdict claims.
